#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""A/B native startup diagnosis using real app routes in an ephemeral test account.

No data injection, no screenshot surrogate, no modified APK, no false success.
The no-GL goal editor is exercised before mounting the botanical Welcome screen.
This is a diagnostic, not the product's complete end-to-end acceptance suite.
"""
import hashlib,importlib.util,json,os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,time

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
OUT=ROOT/'artifacts/native/render-isolation'
OUT.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('cuki_isolation_hierarchy',ROOT/'scripts/native/android-hierarchy.py')
module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module)


def adb(*args,timeout=60,binary=False):
    return subprocess.check_output(['adb',*args],timeout=timeout,text=not binary)


def main():
    report={'binarySource':os.environ.get('CUKI_BINARY_SOURCE_SHA'),'harnessSource':os.environ.get('GITHUB_SHA'),
            'scope':'route/renderer isolation on a test account, not a complete app or visual approval','stages':[],'passed':False}
    stream=(OUT/'live-logcat.txt').open('wb');log=None
    try:
        log=subprocess.Popen(['adb','logcat','-v','threadtime'],stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        apk=ROOT/'apps/mobile/android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk'
        report['apkSha256']=hashlib.sha256(apk.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        start=time.monotonic();adb('install','-r',str(apk),timeout=180)
        report['installationSeconds']=round(time.monotonic()-start,3)
        adb('shell','pm','clear','com.cuki.app.test')
        reader=module.NativeHierarchyReader(OUT)
        for name,route,marker in [('no-gl-goals','cuki://screen/SC-04','SC-04'),('botanical-welcome','cuki://screen/SC-01','SC-01')]:
            item={'name':name,'uri':route,'startedAt':time.time(),'identified':False};report['stages'].append(item)
            adb('shell','am','start','-W','-a','android.intent.action.VIEW','-d',route,'com.cuki.app.test')
            # Preserve an actual framebuffer before requesting the accessibility tree.
            time.sleep(8)
            (OUT/(name+'-before-hierarchy.png')).write_bytes(adb('exec-out','screencap','-p',binary=True))
            end=time.monotonic()+45
            while time.monotonic()<end:
                xml=reader.read();(OUT/(name+'.xml')).write_text(xml)
                if marker in xml:
                    item['identified']=True;break
                time.sleep(1)
            if not item['identified']:raise AssertionError('Native route not identified: '+name)
            (OUT/(name+'.png')).write_bytes(adb('exec-out','screencap','-p',binary=True))
            item['finishedAt']=time.time()
            (OUT/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'
')
        report['passed']=True
    except Exception as error:
        report['error']=str(error)
    finally:
        if log and log.poll() is None:
            log.terminate()
            try:log.wait(timeout=5)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:log.kill();log.wait()
        stream.close()
        (OUT/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'
')
    if not report['passed']:raise SystemExit(1)

if __name__=='__main__':main()
